name: idealist-mcp
description: Idealist (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_idealist_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_IDEALIST_API_KEY
platform_mcp_idealist_api_key.description: Idealist Listings API key; 'API keys are issued manually. Contact support@idealist.org to request a production key.' Sent as the Basic-auth username with an empty password.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the key is verified with a jobs listing request for changes since now ('401 Unauthorized - check your API key').

tools.name: search
tools.description: Incremental feed, not a keyword search: GET /api/v1/listings/jobs 'returns up to 100 jobs, ordered by oldest updated first' and pages with since = the last job's updated value ('since is inclusive, meaning that you should expect to get the last job again'). query, location and page are not sent; pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue (it is set when a full page of 100 came back), and read details with get_posting. hasMore and updated are in raw.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Job details: description (rich text HTML), org, address, applyUrl / applyEmail / applyText, salaryMinimum / salaryMaximum (decimal strings, in raw), salaryPeriod, locationType, expires. '404 Not Found - It can mean a job has expired, has been hidden, etc.'
